[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
let rec loop (xs: List Int) (acc: List Int) : List Int :=
  match xs with
  | [] => acc
  | head :: [] => acc
  | head :: tail =>
    let new_acc := (List.push (head * 1) acc)
    loop tail new_acc
loop xs []
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
[END]
